## Validation and assumptions

All **28/28** screened development records were retrieved. This is development relative recall, not independent validation; no user-supplied seeds, held-out validation set, or benchmark set were available. Overall recall was not estimated, so the strategy remains empirically unvalidated.

I treated the review as assessing methods across a corpus of environmental-health systematic reviews. Methodological rigor terms were tested and left out because their requirement would lose relevant reviews that do not name rigor or quality in searchable metadata. The environmental-health category probe found one relevant review on activity spaces; I widened that block and screened a second probe with no additional relevant records.

Both PRESS-structured internal critic rounds passed without findings. **PRESS peer review by an information specialist is still needed before use.**
